_meta.note: A stdio MCP server supplied at LAUNCH (--additional-mcp-config) completing a round trip: tool_call titled probe-marker, session/request_permission for it, and the server's own marker in tool_call_update. The probe server's log shows it was asked initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list and tools/call by Copilot CLI. A stdio element in the session/new mcpServers array is instead rejected (Copilot CLI's own log: Rejecting non-http/sse MCP server ... from client), with nothing on the wire. A second turn creates a file through its edit tool, which also asks (kind edit). Reductions: session and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the recording host's scratch paths replaced with /work/copilot-probe; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames dropped; authMethods' terminal-auth command normalized to copilot.
